roadmap.meanwhileHint: Every window you label teaches the pattern detector these pages will be built on.
roadmap.previewCaption: Preview · illustrative shapes, not your data

skill.title: Skill
skill.subtitle: Where you stand on every pattern, session after session
skill.previewLabel: Preview of the skill view: a radar per axis and a trend over sessions, not your data

features.axes: A skill estimate for each axis (jack, tech, speed and stream; general, tech, inverse and release for LN) with how sure it is, rebuilt from your own replays.
features.sessions: Session reports: what improved, what got worse and what to practise next.
features.self: Only the names you marked as yours count; other players on this PC never touch your profile.

recommendations.title: Recommendations
recommendations.subtitle: The right chart, section and rate for what you need to train
recommendations.previewLabel: Preview of recommendations: chart, section and rate cards, not real picks

features.picks: A chart, the exact section and a rate aimed at your weakest axis, each with a short reason.
features.feedback: Answer “too easy”, “too hard” or “wrong pattern” and the next picks adjust to you.
features.drills: Cut a section into a drill at the right rate and import it into osu! stable; its replays count back.
